brushed-metal.banner: Drag to inspect the highlights on the steel. Change how rough it is.

car-paint-under-clear-coat.banner: Drag around the car. Change the paint and the clear coat above it.

tab.page.label: All worlds
tab.page.hint: How busy every world and view of the page keeps the GPU and the main thread, as a share of each second; shown only on a page of several worlds or views.

tab.gpu.label: GPU
tab.gpu.hint: Where the graphics processor spends the image, stage by stage.

tab.cpu.label: CPU
tab.cpu.hint: Where the engine spends the CPU time of an image, as means over the last second; the header's CPU figure is the main thread's whole frame. More work per frame raises it.

tab.shadows.label: Shadows
tab.shadows.hint: The shadow passes and their page counters, the last frame's; their time is part of the GPU time.

tab.memory.label: Memory
tab.memory.hint: The GPU memory the engine holds, by kind.

tab.scene.label: Scene
tab.scene.hint: What the cut selected and drew, and the geometry pool.

page.gpuBusy.label: GPU busy
page.gpuBusy.hint: Share of each second the page's worlds and views keep the GPU busy; past 100 % their GPU times overlap and the GPU holds the frame.

page.cpuBusy.label: CPU busy
page.cpuBusy.hint: Share of each second the page's worlds keep the main thread busy; they share one main thread, so it adds up.

page.view.label: view {n}
page.view.hint: GPU time of the last image of a view beside the main one, and its share of the world's frame.

profile.cpuFrame.label: CPU frame
profile.cpuFrame.hint: Main-thread time of the animation-frame callbacks of a frame, as median / 95th percentile over the last second; only with ?profile.

profile.pageHooks.label: Page hooks
profile.pageHooks.hint: Time of the page's own frame hooks in a frame, as median / 95th percentile over the last second; only with ?profile.

profile.engineCpu.label: Engine CPU
profile.engineCpu.hint: The engine's whole-image CPU time, as median / 95th percentile over the last second; only with ?profile.

profile.workerStep.label: Physics worker step
profile.workerStep.hint: The physics worker's slowest fixed step of a tick, as median / 95th percentile over the last second; only with ?profile.

shadows.included.label: included in GPU
shadows.included.hint: These times are already inside the GPU total: never add them to it.

summary.frame.label: Frame
summary.frame.hint: Mean time between two displayed images over the last second, the inverse of the rate; rises when either processor takes longer than a refresh.

summary.gpu.label: GPU
summary.gpu.hint: Mean GPU time of an image over the last second; rises with pixels, lights and geometry drawn.

summary.cpu.label: CPU
summary.cpu.hint: Mean main-thread time of a frame over the last second; rises with the work sent to the GPU.

summary.wait.label: Wait
summary.wait.hint: The mean frame less the busier processor: time spent waiting for the next refresh, the two processors running side by side.

summary.toNext.label: One refresh sooner
summary.toNext.hint: The time the processor that holds the frame must give up for its images to land one refresh sooner, and the rate they would then reach.

summary.bound.label: Limited by
summary.bound.hint: What held the frame over the last second: the processor whose time set how many refreshes a typical image stayed on screen, or the display's pacing when neither did.

summary.screen.label: Screen {hz} Hz
summary.screen.hint: How long each image stays on screen, counted in the display's refreshes: 1 is every refresh, more means images are late.

summary.screenValue.label: 1 image / {n} refreshes
summary.screenValue.hint: The refreshes a typical image of the last second stayed on screen.

summary.screenShare.label: {share} % of images in {n} refreshes
summary.screenShare.hint: One bucket of the screen distribution: its share of the last second's images.

summary.screenShareOrMore.label: {share} % in {n} or more
summary.screenShareOrMore.hint: The last bucket of the screen distribution: its share of the images, at that many refreshes or more.

summary.gpuIdle.label: GPU idle
summary.gpuIdle.hint: Mean time the GPU sat idle before an image over the last second, at most: the work timed between the images left out, work nobody timed counted in; rises when the CPU feeds it late.

summary.mainView.label: main view
summary.mainView.hint: The first world the page made, the page's main view.

summary.world.label: world
summary.world.hint: A world of the page other than the main view.

summary.budget.label: budget
summary.budget.hint: The time one display refresh allows a frame; the dashed line of the graph.

panel.hint.label: Click: compact · drag: move · key ` / ²

summary.cpuShort.label: CPU
summary.cpuShort.hint: The main thread time of a frame.

summary.gpuShort.label: GPU
summary.gpuShort.hint: The graphics processor time of an image.

row.max.label: max
row.max.hint: The highest value in the last second.

summary.held.label: held
summary.held.hint: No new frame in the last second: nothing moved, the image is redisplayed.

summary.last.label: last
summary.last.hint: The GPU time shown is an earlier image's: the device has not sampled a newer one yet.

gpu.physics.label: Physics
gpu.physics.hint: Rigid and soft body steps on the GPU; rises with the bodies simulated.

gpu.animations.label: Animations
gpu.animations.hint: Skinning and deformation of animated objects; rises with the animated vertices.

gpu.lights.label: Lights
gpu.lights.hint: Preparing the scene lights for the frame; rises with the light count.

gpu.cutAdoption.label: Cut adoption
gpu.cutAdoption.hint: Taking in the cut the selection chose; rises when the cut changes much between images.

gpu.selection.label: Selection
gpu.selection.hint: Choosing which clusters to draw by view and detail; rises with the hierarchy nodes tested.

gpu.transparents.label: Transparents
gpu.transparents.hint: Drawing see-through surfaces; rises with transparent triangles and layers.

gpu.residency.label: Residency
gpu.residency.hint: Deciding which geometry pages must be in memory; rises while the view changes.

gpu.hostPages.label: Host pages
gpu.hostPages.hint: Copying page data the CPU streamed to the GPU; rises while new pages arrive.

gpu.uploads.label: Uploads
gpu.uploads.hint: Sending data to GPU buffers; rises with dynamic geometry and streaming.

gpu.textures.label: Textures
gpu.textures.hint: Streaming and decoding texture levels; rises while new textures load.

gpu.encode.label: Encode
gpu.encode.hint: Building the commands the raster stage reads; rises with the draw batches.

gpu.submit.label: Submit
gpu.submit.hint: Passes that hand work to the queue; rises with the number of submissions.

gpu.hiZ.label: Hi-Z
gpu.hiZ.hint: Building the depth pyramid the occlusion test reads; rises with the resolution.

gpu.geometry.label: Geometry
gpu.geometry.hint: Rasterising the visibility buffer and writing surfaces; rises with triangles drawn and pixels covered.

gpu.coplanar.label: Coplanar
gpu.coplanar.hint: Resolving surfaces that lie on the same plane; rises with overlapping decals.

gpu.shadows.label: Shadows
gpu.shadows.hint: Rendering and projecting shadow pages; rises with the lights that cast and the pages redrawn.

gpu.lightLists.label: Light lists
gpu.lightLists.hint: Gathering the lights that reach each screen tile; rises with the light count and their reach.

gpu.bounce.label: Bounce
gpu.bounce.hint: Light bounced between surfaces; rises with the rays traced.

gpu.reflections.label: Reflections
gpu.reflections.hint: Reflected images of the scene; rises with reflective pixels and the rays traced.

gpu.lighting.label: Lighting
gpu.lighting.hint: Shading every pixel from its surface and the lights; rises with pixels and lights.

gpu.antialiasing.label: Antialiasing
gpu.antialiasing.hint: Smoothing edges over time; rises with the resolution.

gpu.effects.label: Effects
gpu.effects.hint: Post-processing such as bloom, exposure and fog; rises with the effects switched on and the resolution.

gpu.present.label: Present
gpu.present.hint: Resampling and handing the image to the display; rises with the display resolution.

gpu.unclassified.label: Unclassified
gpu.unclassified.hint: Timed passes that no stage names; they are listed so the stages still add up.

gpu.untimed.label: Outside timed passes
gpu.untimed.hint: GPU time of the image no timed pass covers: copies, gaps between passes, timestamp resolves.

cpu.physics.label: Physics
cpu.physics.hint: Stepping the simulation on the main thread; rises with the bodies simulated.

cpu.animations.label: Animations
cpu.animations.hint: Preparing animated objects on the main thread; rises with the animated objects.

cpu.textures.label: Textures
cpu.textures.hint: Feeding the texture streamer on the main thread; rises while new textures load.

cpu.transparents.label: Transparents
cpu.transparents.hint: Preparing and drawing see-through surfaces; rises with transparent meshes and layers.

cpu.cutAdoption.label: Cut adoption
cpu.cutAdoption.hint: Taking in the cut the selection chose; rises when the cut changes much between images.

cpu.residency.label: Residency
cpu.residency.hint: Deciding and queuing which geometry pages must be in memory; rises while the view changes.

cpu.uploads.label: Uploads
cpu.uploads.hint: Sending data to GPU buffers; rises with dynamic geometry and streaming.

cpu.selection.label: Selection
cpu.selection.hint: Dispatching the cluster selection; rises with the hierarchy nodes tested.

cpu.encode.label: Encode
cpu.encode.hint: Recording the GPU commands; rises with passes and draw batches.

cpu.submit.label: Submit
cpu.submit.hint: Handing the recorded commands to the queue; rises with the number of submissions.

cpu.hostPages.label: Host pages
cpu.hostPages.hint: Integrating geometry pages the CPU streamed; rises while new pages arrive.

cpu.rest.label: Rest of the frame
cpu.rest.hint: The engine's whole-image CPU time that no stage above covers (0 when work outside the image makes the stages exceed it); page scripts, input and layout are not in it.

shadows.invalidation.label: Invalidation
shadows.invalidation.hint: Marking shadow pages stale after something moved; rises with moving casters.

shadows.marking.label: Marking
shadows.marking.hint: Finding which shadow pages the view needs; rises with the pixels lit by shadowed lights.

shadows.pageManagement.label: Page management
shadows.pageManagement.hint: Allocating and recycling shadow pages; rises with the pages requested.

shadows.render.label: Render
shadows.render.hint: Drawing the shadow pages that changed; rises with the pages redrawn and the casters in them.

shadows.projection.label: Projection
shadows.projection.hint: Projecting shadow maps onto the image; rises with the shadowed lights and the resolution.

shadows.lights.label: Shadowed lights
shadows.lights.hint: Lights that cast virtual shadow maps this frame; the scene count in Scene is all active lights.

shadows.maps.label: Maps
shadows.maps.hint: Virtual shadow maps this frame; rises with the lights that cast.

shadows.pagesRequested.label: Shadow pages requested
shadows.pagesRequested.hint: Shadow pages the frame asked for; rises with the shadowed area on screen.

shadows.pagesAllocated.label: Shadow pages allocated
shadows.pagesAllocated.hint: Shadow pages newly taken from the pool this frame; rises when the view or lights move.

shadows.pagesCached.label: Shadow pages cached
shadows.pagesCached.hint: Requested shadow pages found already drawn; falls when casters or lights move.

shadows.pagesRendered.label: Shadow pages rendered
shadows.pagesRendered.hint: Shadow pages cleared and drawn this frame; rises when casters or lights move.

shadows.freePages.label: Shadow pages free
shadows.freePages.hint: Physical shadow pages left in the pool; falls when more are requested.

shadows.lodBias.label: Shadow detail bias
shadows.lodBias.hint: How much coarser than asked the shadow maps are drawn; rises when the pool is full.

shadows.projectionPasses.label: Projection passes
shadows.projectionPasses.hint: Projection passes this frame, four lights each; rises with the shadowed lights.

shadows.resolutionBias.label: Shadow resolution bias
shadows.resolutionBias.hint: Levels the shadows draw coarser than asked because of their pool; 0 is healthy.

memory.screen.label: Screen images
memory.screen.hint: Targets that depend on the resolution; rises with the render size.

memory.shadows.label: Shadow pool
memory.shadows.hint: The shadow page pool; rises with the shadow quality setting.

memory.geometry.label: Geometry
memory.geometry.hint: The geometry page pool reserved on the GPU, used or not; its use is in Scene.

memory.textures.label: Texture pool
memory.textures.hint: The texture pool, fixed for the session; set by the texture budget.

memory.liveTextures.label: Live textures
memory.liveTextures.hint: Working textures kept apart from the pool; rises with the live textures in the scene.

memory.other.label: Other resources
memory.other.hint: GPU memory no kind above names: buffers, history images, caches.

scene.trianglesSelected.label: Triangles selected
scene.trianglesSelected.hint: Triangles the cut kept past the view and detail tests; rises with scene detail in view.

scene.trianglesDrawn.label: Triangles drawn
scene.trianglesDrawn.hint: Triangles drawn once occlusion dropped the hidden ones; rises with visible detail.

scene.trianglesScene.label: Triangles (scene)
scene.trianglesScene.hint: Triangles of the visible meshes in the scene, counted by the page when the frame publishes no selected triangles.

scene.drawCalls.label: Draw calls
scene.drawCalls.hint: Draw commands sent this frame; rises with the number of batches.

scene.geometryPages.label: Geometry pages
scene.geometryPages.hint: Geometry pages resident in memory; rises with the detail loaded.

scene.poolUsed.label: Geometry pool used
scene.poolUsed.hint: Bytes of the geometry pool that hold pages; rises as pages load.

scene.poolCapacity.label: Geometry pool capacity
scene.poolCapacity.hint: Bytes reserved for the geometry pool; set by the scene and the device limits.

scene.lights.label: Lights
scene.lights.hint: Scene lights that lit the frame.

pass.compose roots.label: compose roots
pass.compose roots.hint: Computes the world matrix of every placement root from its parents; rises with the number of animated or moving placements.

pass.compose motion.label: compose motion
pass.compose motion.hint: Computes how each placement moved since the previous image, for motion vectors; rises with the number of moving placements.

pass.compose rows.label: compose rows
pass.compose rows.hint: Computes the world matrices of the placement rows; rises with the number of placements.

pass.root boxes.label: root boxes
pass.root boxes.hint: Fits the world box and stretch of every placement root; rises with the number of roots.

pass.placement tree leaves.label: placement tree leaves
pass.placement tree leaves.hint: Fits the boxes of the placement tree's leaves; rises with the number of placements.

pass.placement tree refit.label: placement tree refit
pass.placement tree refit.hint: Refits the placement tree's inner boxes after its leaves moved; rises with the number of moving placements.

pass.DAG selection.label: DAG selection
pass.DAG selection.hint: Walks the geometry graph and selects the detail each view needs; rises with the detail in view.

pass.HiZ.label: HiZ
pass.HiZ.hint: Builds the depth pyramid used to hide what is occluded; rises with the render size.

pass.visibility primary.label: visibility primary
pass.visibility primary.hint: Draws the depth of the occluders so the rest can be tested against it; rises with the occluders in view.

pass.visibility secondary.label: visibility secondary
pass.visibility secondary.hint: Draws the tested half of the geometry against the occluders' depth; rises with the geometry that passed the test.

pass.raster binning.label: raster binning
pass.raster binning.hint: Decodes the visible clusters, sorts them into the draw batches of the hardware raster and lists the software raster's; rises with the clusters in view.

pass.raster occluder depth.label: raster occluder depth
pass.raster occluder depth.hint: Software raster of the occluders' depth, a group of lanes to a cluster; rises with the small occluding triangles.

pass.raster tested depth.label: raster tested depth
pass.raster tested depth.hint: Software raster of the depth of the tested geometry; rises with the small triangles tested.

pass.raster identifiers.label: raster identifiers
pass.raster identifiers.hint: Software raster of the surface identifiers, on a device without the 64-bit atomic maximum; rises with the small triangles drawn.

pass.raster occluder hiz.label: raster occluder hiz
pass.raster occluder hiz.hint: Writes the occluders' depth of the visibility buffer into the depth pyramid's first level; rises with the render size.

pass.raster resolve.label: raster resolve
pass.raster resolve.hint: Writes the surface identifiers of the visibility buffer into the image the materials read; rises with the render size.

pass.empty surfaces.label: empty surfaces
pass.empty surfaces.hint: Clears the surface images when the image draws no material; small and fixed.

pass.material surfaces.label: material surfaces
pass.material surfaces.hint: Clears the surface and feedback images before the materials are shaded; rises with the render size.

pass.texture feedback reduce.label: texture feedback reduce
pass.texture feedback reduce.hint: Reduces which texture tiles the image asked for; rises with the textures in view.

pass.texture eviction queue.label: texture eviction queue
pass.texture eviction queue.hint: Ranks the texture tiles to give up when the pool is full; rises with the pool's size.

pass.transparents.label: transparents
pass.transparents.hint: Draws the transparent surfaces layer by layer; rises with the transparent surfaces in view.

pass.blend companion.label: blend companion
pass.blend companion.hint: Draws the companion image of the dual blend; rises with the transparent surfaces in view.

pass.distortion.label: distortion
pass.distortion.hint: Accumulates the refraction of the transmissive surfaces; rises with their number and size on screen.

pass.distortion apply.label: distortion apply
pass.distortion apply.hint: Applies the accumulated refraction to the image; rises with the render size.

pass.transparent compaction.label: transparent compaction
pass.transparent compaction.hint: Compacts the visible transparent draws; rises with the transparent geometry.

pass.transparent occlusion.label: transparent occlusion
pass.transparent occlusion.hint: Tests the transparent geometry against the depth; rises with the transparent geometry.

pass.blend order and expansion.label: blend order and expansion
pass.blend order and expansion.hint: Orders and expands the transparent surfaces for blending; rises with the transparent surfaces in view.

pass.display mask.label: display mask
pass.display mask.hint: Builds the mask of the pixels the display filter acts on; rises with the render size.

pass.display filter.label: display filter
pass.display filter.hint: Applies the display filter over the image; rises with the render size.

pass.transparent front.label: transparent front
pass.transparent front.hint: Keeps the transparents' front surface the reflections trace against; rises with the render size.

pass.particle draw.label: particle draw
pass.particle draw.hint: Draws the particles; rises with the particles alive and the area they cover.

pass.light tiles.label: light tiles
pass.light tiles.hint: Builds the per-tile light lists; rises with the lights and the render size.

pass.bounce.label: bounce
pass.bounce.hint: Updates the bounced light: marks the cells in view, writes the table and refreshes the probes; rises with the lit cells in view.

pass.proxy pose.label: proxy pose
pass.proxy pose.hint: Poses the proxies of the deformed placements for the reflections and the bounce; rises with the deformed placements.

pass.reflections.label: reflections
pass.reflections.hint: Reduces the depth pyramid for the reflections; rises with the render size.

pass.reflection trace.label: reflection trace
pass.reflection trace.hint: Classifies the screen tiles and traces the reflections through the screen; rises with the reflective pixels.

pass.reflection scene.label: reflection scene
pass.reflection scene.hint: Traces the rays the screen could not answer through the scene; rises with the reflective pixels the screen missed.

pass.particles.label: particles
pass.particles.hint: Simulates the particles' step; rises with the particles alive.

pass.as is share seed.label: as is share seed
pass.as is share seed.hint: Seeds the share of the image kept as it is by the temporal resolve; rises with the render size.

pass.exposure.label: exposure
pass.exposure.hint: Meters the image's brightness and updates the automatic exposure; small and fixed.

pass.scene downsample.label: scene downsample
pass.scene downsample.hint: Builds the chain of ever smaller copies of the image read by the bloom and the local exposure; rises with the render size.

pass.local exposure.label: local exposure
pass.local exposure.hint: Adapts the exposure region by region; rises with the render size.

pass.bloom.label: bloom
pass.bloom.hint: Spreads the bright parts of the image into a glow; rises with the render size.

pass.outline.label: outline
pass.outline.hint: Scans and draws the outlines of the selected objects; rises with the render size and the outlines asked.

pass.HDR composition.label: HDR composition
pass.HDR composition.hint: Composes the final image from the lit image and the effects; rises with the render size.

pass.HDR composition + present.label: HDR composition + present
pass.HDR composition + present.hint: Composes the final image and presents it to the screen in one pass; rises with the render size.

pass.direct present.label: direct present
pass.direct present.hint: Draws the image straight to the screen; rises with the render size.

pass.view present.label: view present
pass.view present.hint: Draws the image into a view of the page; rises with the view's size.

pass.guides.label: guides
pass.guides.hint: Draws the guides over the image; rises with the guides shown.

pass.x ray.label: x ray
pass.x ray.hint: Draws the edges of the x-ray view over the lit image; rises with the render size.

pass.frame difference.label: frame difference
pass.frame difference.hint: Shows the image against the one before it; rises with the render size.

pass.see through background.label: see through background
pass.see through background.hint: Lays the background of the see-through views before their transparents; rises with the render size.

pass.capture emission and occlusion.label: capture emission and occlusion
pass.capture emission and occlusion.hint: Captures the emission and occlusion layer of the surfaces; rises with the render size.

pass.texture mips.label: texture mips
pass.texture mips.hint: Builds the smaller levels of the textures just loaded; rises with the textures uploaded.

pass.deformation.label: deformation
pass.deformation.hint: Deforms the geometry of the deformed placements; rises with their vertices.

pass.animation banks.label: animation banks
pass.animation banks.hint: Plays the animation banks of the crowds; rises with the animated instances.

pass.vsm.label: vsm
pass.vsm.hint: Any pass of the virtual shadow maps: render, clear, projection and merge of the shadow pages; rises with the shadowed lights and the pages they need.

pass.vsm castDiff.label: VSM caster changes
pass.vsm castDiff.hint: Finds the shadow casters that moved, appeared or left since the last image, so only their pages are drawn again; rises with the casters.

pass.vsm marking.label: VSM page marking
pass.vsm marking.hint: Marks the shadow pages the visible pixels need, light by light; rises with the render size and the shadowed lights.

pass.vsm pageMapping.label: VSM page mapping
pass.vsm pageMapping.hint: Gives each marked shadow page a place in the page pool, keeping the cached ones; rises with the pages marked.

pass.vsm afterRaster.label: VSM after raster
pass.vsm afterRaster.hint: Updates the page tables once the pages are drawn: what is cached, what is drawn; rises with the pages.

pass.vsm filterable.label: VSM filterable pages
pass.vsm filterable.hint: Prepares the drawn pages for filtered reads by the soft shadows; rises with the pages drawn.

pass.vsm invalidateCastPages.label: VSM page invalidation
pass.vsm invalidateCastPages.hint: Marks the cached pages that the moved casters touch as stale, so they are drawn again; rises with the moving casters.

pass.vsm occlusion build.label: VSM occlusion pyramid
pass.vsm occlusion build.hint: Builds the depth pyramid of the drawn pages that the second cull tests the casters against; rises with the pages.

pass.vsm projection.label: VSM projection
pass.vsm projection.hint: Projects the shadow pages onto the image: the shadow mask of each light; rises with the render size and the shadowed lights.

pass.vsm projection hair.label: VSM hair projection
pass.vsm projection hair.hint: Projects the shadow pages onto the hair strands; rises with the strands on screen.

pass.vsm projection perLight clear.label: VSM per-light mask clear
pass.vsm projection perLight clear.hint: Clears the per-light shadow masks before they are projected; rises with the render size and the lights.

pass.vsm projection perLight project.label: VSM per-light projection
pass.vsm projection perLight project.hint: Projects each light's shadow pages into its own mask; rises with the render size and the shadowed lights.

pass.vsm accumulateStats.label: VSM page statistics
pass.vsm accumulateStats.hint: Adds up the shadow pages requested, allocated and cached for the instruments; a small fixed cost.

pass.vsm visualize.label: VSM page view
pass.vsm visualize.hint: Draws the virtual shadow maps' debug view of the pages; only while that view is shown.

pass.vsm render cull.label: VSM cull
pass.vsm render cull.hint: Culls the casters against the marked pages before they are drawn into them; rises with the casters and the pages.

pass.vsm render raster.label: VSM raster
pass.vsm render raster.hint: Draws the casters into the marked shadow pages with the hardware raster; rises with the triangles drawn.

pass.vsm render software.label: VSM software raster
pass.vsm render software.hint: Draws the small triangles of the casters into the pages with the compute raster; rises with the small triangles.

pass.vsm render cullSecond.label: VSM second cull
pass.vsm render cullSecond.hint: Culls again the casters the first pass left out, tested against the occlusion pyramid; rises with the casters.

pass.vsm render rasterSecond.label: VSM second raster
pass.vsm render rasterSecond.hint: Draws the casters the second cull kept, with the hardware raster; rises with their triangles.

pass.vsm render softwareSecond.label: VSM second software raster
pass.vsm render softwareSecond.hint: Draws the small triangles the second cull kept, with the compute raster; rises with them.

pass.vsm render atlas clear.label: shadow atlas clear
pass.vsm render atlas clear.hint: Clears the classic shadow atlas's layers before the casters are drawn into them; rises with the atlas size.

pass.vsm render atlas raster.label: shadow atlas raster
pass.vsm render atlas raster.hint: Draws the casters into the classic shadow atlas, a layer at a time; rises with the triangles drawn.

pass.vsm render atlas sort.label: shadow atlas sort
pass.vsm render atlas sort.hint: Sorts the casters' draws by atlas tile before the atlas is drawn; rises with the draws.

pass.vsm render atlas out.label: shadow atlas copy
pass.vsm render atlas out.hint: Copies the classic shadow atlas's tiles into the page pool; rises with the tiles.

pass.vsm denoise.label: VSM denoise
pass.vsm denoise.hint: Filters the shadow masks' noise, guided by the depth and the normals; rises with the render size and the soft shadows.

pass.vsm denoise tiles.label: VSM denoise tiles
pass.vsm denoise tiles.hint: Finds the tiles of the image where the shadows are soft, the only ones the denoise filters; rises with the penumbras on screen.

pass.vsm firstPersonSelfShadow.label: first-person self shadow
pass.vsm firstPersonSelfShadow.hint: Traces the first-person body's shadow on itself; only with a first-person view.

pass.vsm firstPersonSelfShadow merge.label: first-person shadow merge
pass.vsm firstPersonSelfShadow merge.hint: Merges the first-person self shadow into the local lights' masks; only with a first-person view.

pass.vsm rayTracedShadow.label: ray-traced shadows
pass.vsm rayTracedShadow.hint: Traces the shadows of the lights asked to be ray traced against the distance fields; rises with the render size and those lights.

pass.vsm rayTracedShadow merge.label: ray-traced shadow merge
pass.vsm rayTracedShadow merge.hint: Merges the ray-traced shadows into the local lights' masks; rises with the render size.

pass.hair strands bounds and tangents.label: hair bounds and tangents
pass.hair strands bounds and tangents.hint: Computes the strands' tangents and the bounds of their groups; rises with the strands.

pass.hair strands voxelization.label: hair voxelization
pass.hair strands voxelization.hint: Writes the strands' density into the voxel volume the lighting and the shadows read; rises with the strands and the volume.

pass.hair strands scattering table.label: hair scattering table
pass.hair strands scattering table.hint: Builds the table of how light scatters in a hair fibre; once, when the hair's settings change.

pass.hair strands visibility.label: hair visibility
pass.hair strands visibility.hint: Rasters the strands' visibility samples and compacts them per pixel; rises with the strands on screen.

pass.hair strands visibility draw.label: hair visibility draw
pass.hair strands visibility draw.hint: Draws the strands into the multisampled visibility target; rises with the strands on screen.

pass.hair strands visibility resolve.label: hair visibility resolve
pass.hair strands visibility resolve.hint: Resolves the multisampled visibility into the strands' samples per pixel; rises with the render size.

pass.hair strands depth under full cover.label: hair full-coverage depth
pass.hair strands depth under full cover.hint: Writes the depth of the pixels the strands cover wholly, so the surfaces behind are not shaded; rises with the strands on screen.

pass.hair strands coverage count.label: hair coverage count
pass.hair strands coverage count.hint: Counts the strands covering each pixel; rises with the strands on screen.

pass.hair strands coverage mapping.label: hair coverage mapping
pass.hair strands coverage mapping.hint: Turns the counts into the coverage the composition blends with; rises with the render size.

pass.hair strands forward visibility.label: hair forward visibility
pass.hair strands forward visibility.hint: Bins and rasters the strands of the forward path into its depth grid; rises with the strands on screen.

pass.hair strands forward colour raster.label: hair forward colour
pass.hair strands forward colour raster.hint: Rasters the forward path's strands with their lit colours; rises with the strands on screen.

pass.hair strands curve raster clear out.label: hair curve raster clear
pass.hair strands curve raster clear out.hint: Clears the curve raster's output before the strands are drawn; rises with the render size.

pass.hair strands curve raster pipeline.label: hair curve raster
pass.hair strands curve raster pipeline.hint: Rasters the strands as curves in tiles; rises with the strands on screen.

pass.hair strands curve raster compose.label: hair curve compose
pass.hair strands curve raster compose.hint: Lays the curve raster's output onto the image; rises with the render size.

pass.hair strands transmittance.label: hair transmittance
pass.hair strands transmittance.hint: Draws how much light passes through the strands towards each light; rises with the strands and the lights.

pass.hair strands transmittance resolve.label: hair transmittance resolve
pass.hair strands transmittance resolve.hint: Resolves the multisampled transmittance per pixel; rises with the render size.

pass.hair strands deep shadow allocate.label: hair deep shadow allocate
pass.hair strands deep shadow allocate.hint: Gives each light's deep shadow map its place in the atlas; rises with the shadowed lights.

pass.hair strands deep shadow front dept.label: hair deep shadow front
pass.hair strands deep shadow front dept.hint: Draws the nearest strand depth of each light's deep shadow map; rises with the strands and the lights.

pass.hair strands deep shadow layers.label: hair deep shadow layers
pass.hair strands deep shadow layers.hint: Draws the strands' density in layers behind that front; rises with the strands and the lights.

pass.hair strands light.label: hair lighting
pass.hair strands light.hint: Lights the strands' samples with the scene's lights; rises with the strands on screen and the lights.

pass.hair strands light transmittance.label: hair light transmittance
pass.hair strands light transmittance.hint: Reads each light's transmittance through the strands into their lighting; rises with the strands and the lights.

pass.hair strands sampled lights.label: hair sampled lights
pass.hair strands sampled lights.hint: Lights the strands with the lights the many-light sampling picks; rises with the strands on screen.

pass.hair strands static light.label: hair static light
pass.hair strands static light.hint: Gathers the static lighting of the strands from the light maps and volumes; rises with the strands.

pass.hair strands environment sh sky.label: hair sky (harmonics)
pass.hair strands environment sh sky.hint: Lights the strands with the sky through its spherical harmonics; rises with the strands.

pass.hair strands environment adhoc sky.label: hair sky (approximate)
pass.hair strands environment adhoc sky.hint: Lights the strands with the sky through the approximate integration; rises with the strands.

pass.hair strands environment uniform sk.label: hair sky (sampled)
pass.hair strands environment uniform sk.hint: Lights the strands with the sky by sampling it uniformly through the voxels; rises with the strands.

pass.hair strands sky occlusion.label: hair sky occlusion
pass.hair strands sky occlusion.hint: Darkens the sky light of the surfaces under the strands; rises with the render size.

pass.hair strands shadow on the surfaces.label: hair shadow on surfaces
pass.hair strands shadow on the surfaces.hint: Casts the strands' shadow onto the surfaces; rises with the render size and the shadowed lights.

pass.hair strands g buffer override.label: hair surface override
pass.hair strands g buffer override.hint: Writes the strands into the surfaces' buffers so the lighting treats them as surfaces; rises with the strands on screen.

pass.hair strands g buffer override dept.label: hair surface override depth
pass.hair strands g buffer override dept.hint: Writes the depth of the strands written into the surfaces' buffers; rises with the strands on screen.

pass.hair strands composition.label: hair composition
pass.hair strands composition.hint: Lays the lit strands onto the image with their coverage; rises with the render size.

pass.hair strands custom depth.label: hair custom depth
pass.hair strands custom depth.hint: Writes the strands into the custom depth the outline and the post materials read; only where asked.

pass.hair strands debug lines.label: hair debug lines
pass.hair strands debug lines.hint: Draws the lines of the hair's debug view; only while it is shown.

pass.hair strands debug lines frusta.label: hair debug frusta
pass.hair strands debug lines frusta.hint: Writes the lines of the light frusta of the hair's debug view; only while it is shown.

pass.hair strands debug lines macro.label: hair debug groups
pass.hair strands debug lines macro.hint: Writes the lines of the strands' group boxes of the hair's debug view; only while it is shown.

pass.hair strands debug lines nodes.label: hair debug nodes
pass.hair strands debug lines nodes.hint: Writes the lines of the strands' tree nodes of the hair's debug view; only while it is shown.

pass.hair strands debug panels atlas.label: hair debug atlas
pass.hair strands debug panels atlas.hint: Draws the hair's debug panel of the deep shadow atlas; only while it is shown.

pass.hair strands debug panels voxels.label: hair debug voxels
pass.hair strands debug panels voxels.hint: Draws the hair's debug panel of the voxel volume; only while it is shown.

pass.sun distance field shadow cull.label: sun field shadow cull
pass.sun distance field shadow cull.hint: Culls the meshes' distance fields against the sun's shadow tiles; rises with the meshes.

pass.sun distance field shadow offsets.label: sun field shadow offsets
pass.sun distance field shadow offsets.hint: Lays out each tile's list of the meshes that shadow it; rises with the tiles.

pass.sun distance field shadow count til.label: sun field shadow tile count
pass.sun distance field shadow count til.hint: Counts the meshes each shadow tile holds; rises with the meshes.

pass.sun distance field shadow write til.label: sun field shadow tile write
pass.sun distance field shadow write til.hint: Writes the meshes into each shadow tile's list; rises with the meshes.

pass.distance field occlusion grid.label: field occlusion grid
pass.distance field occlusion grid.hint: Builds the grid of the meshes the distance-field occlusion traces; rises with the meshes.

pass.distance field occlusion cull.label: field occlusion cull
pass.distance field occlusion cull.hint: Culls the meshes' distance fields against the screen tiles; rises with the meshes.

pass.distance field occlusion offsets.label: field occlusion offsets
pass.distance field occlusion offsets.hint: Lays out each screen tile's list of meshes; rises with the tiles.

pass.distance field occlusion count tile.label: field occlusion tile count
pass.distance field occlusion count tile.hint: Counts the meshes each screen tile holds; rises with the meshes.

pass.distance field occlusion write tile.label: field occlusion tile write
pass.distance field occlusion write tile.hint: Writes the meshes into each screen tile's list; rises with the meshes.

pass.distance field occlusion cones.label: field occlusion cones
pass.distance field occlusion cones.hint: Traces the occlusion cones through the distance fields; rises with the render size.

pass.distance field occlusion history.label: field occlusion history
pass.distance field occlusion history.hint: Blends the occlusion with the last images'; rises with the render size.

pass.distance field occlusion pack.label: field occlusion pack
pass.distance field occlusion pack.hint: Packs the occlusion for the lighting to read; rises with the render size.

pass.global distance field reset.label: global field reset
pass.global distance field reset.hint: Clears the global distance field's pages before it is rebuilt; when the field is reset.

pass.global distance field update, stati.label: global field update (static)
pass.global distance field update, stati.hint: Rebuilds the global distance field's pages the still meshes changed; rises with the pages updated.

pass.global distance field update, movab.label: global field update (movable)
pass.global distance field update, movab.hint: Rebuilds the global distance field's pages the moving meshes touch; rises with them.

pass.global distance field page statisti.label: global field statistics
pass.global distance field page statisti.hint: Counts the global distance field's pages for its debug view; only while it is shown.

pass.mesh distance field streaming.label: mesh field streaming
pass.mesh distance field streaming.hint: Brings the meshes' distance fields in and out of the atlas; rises with the fields streamed.

pass.sky light face.label: sky light capture face
pass.sky light face.hint: Draws one face of the sky light's cube capture; rises with the capture's size.

pass.sky light clouds.label: sky light clouds
pass.sky light clouds.hint: Traces the clouds into the sky light's capture; rises with the capture's size.

pass.sky light sky table.label: sky light sky table
pass.sky light sky table.hint: Builds the sky table the sky light's capture reads; rises with the table's size.

pass.sky light copy.label: sky light copy
pass.sky light copy.hint: Copies the captured cube for its filtering; rises with the capture's size.

pass.sky light mips.label: sky light mips
pass.sky light mips.hint: Builds the smaller levels of the captured cube; rises with its size.

pass.sky light filter.label: sky light filter
pass.sky light filter.hint: Filters the captured cube for the rough reflections; rises with its size.

pass.sky light harmonics.label: sky light harmonics
pass.sky light harmonics.hint: Sums the captured cube into spherical harmonics for the diffuse sky light; a small fixed cost.

pass.sky light table.label: traced sky light table
pass.sky light table.hint: Builds the sky table the traced sky light reads; rises with the table's size.

pass.sky light directions.label: traced sky light directions
pass.sky light directions.hint: Chooses the directions the traced sky light samples; rises with the render size.

pass.sky light trace.label: traced sky light
pass.sky light trace.hint: Traces the sky light's occlusion through the scene; rises with the render size.

pass.sky light composite.label: traced sky light composite
pass.sky light composite.hint: Lays the traced sky light onto the image; rises with the render size.

pass.sky meshes face.label: sky meshes face
pass.sky meshes face.hint: Draws the sky meshes into a face of the sky's capture; rises with the sky meshes.

pass.sky meshes copy.label: sky meshes copy
pass.sky meshes copy.hint: Copies the sky meshes' capture for the sky to read; rises with its size.

pass.cloud depth range.label: cloud depth range
pass.cloud depth range.hint: Finds the depth range the clouds are traced over; rises with the render size.

pass.cloud empty space.label: cloud empty space
pass.cloud empty space.hint: Finds the empty space the cloud trace can skip; rises with the render size.

pass.cloud trace.label: cloud trace
pass.cloud trace.hint: Marches the rays through the cloud layer; rises with the render size and the clouds' quality.

pass.cloud haze.label: cloud haze
pass.cloud haze.hint: Traces the haze in and under the clouds; rises with the render size.

pass.cloud reconstruction.label: cloud reconstruction
pass.cloud reconstruction.hint: Rebuilds the full clouds from the traced pixels and the last images; rises with the render size.

pass.cloud composition.label: cloud composition
pass.cloud composition.hint: Lays the clouds onto the image; rises with the render size.

pass.cloud composition behind water.label: clouds behind water
pass.cloud composition behind water.hint: Lays the clouds onto the image seen through the water; rises with the water on screen.

pass.cloud holdout.label: cloud holdout
pass.cloud holdout.hint: Cuts the clouds out where the image's alpha is held out; rises with the render size.

pass.cloud shadow.label: cloud shadow
pass.cloud shadow.hint: Traces the clouds' shadow map for the sun; rises with the map's size.

pass.cloud sky occlusion.label: cloud sky occlusion
pass.cloud sky occlusion.hint: Traces how much of the sky the clouds hide, for the sky light; rises with the map's size.

pass.cloud lightning volume.label: cloud lightning volume
pass.cloud lightning volume.hint: Builds the volume the lightning lights the clouds with; when the clouds change.

pass.cloud layout pattern.label: cloud layout pattern
pass.cloud layout pattern.hint: Builds the pattern the clouds' layout reads; when the clouds change.

pass.fog local volumes cull.label: fog volumes cull
pass.fog local volumes cull.hint: Culls the local fog volumes against the froxel tiles; rises with the volumes.

pass.fog local volumes sky.label: fog volumes sky
pass.fog local volumes sky.hint: Lights the local fog volumes with the sky; rises with the volumes.

pass.path tracer light grid.label: path tracer light grid
pass.path tracer light grid.hint: Builds the grid of the lights the path tracer samples; when the lights change.

pass.path tracer air optical depth.label: path tracer air depth
pass.path tracer air optical depth.hint: Builds the air's optical depth table the path tracer reads; when the atmosphere changes.

pass.path tracer cloud acceleration map.label: path tracer cloud map
pass.path tracer cloud acceleration map.hint: Builds the map the path tracer skips the empty clouds with; when the clouds change.

pass.path tracer sky table.label: path tracer sky table
pass.path tracer sky table.hint: Builds the sky table the path tracer samples; when the sky changes.

pass.path tracer sample.label: path tracer sample
pass.path tracer sample.hint: Traces the path tracer's samples for the image; rises with the render size and the bounces.

pass.path tracer error mips.label: path tracer error mips
pass.path tracer error mips.hint: Builds the levels of the samples' error the adaptive sampling reads; rises with the render size.

pass.path tracer normal space.label: path tracer normal space
pass.path tracer normal space.hint: Writes the normals and depth the denoiser is guided by; rises with the render size.

pass.path tracer denoiser.label: path tracer denoiser
pass.path tracer denoiser.hint: Denoises the path-traced image; rises with the render size.

pass.path tracer denoiser motion view.label: path tracer motion view
pass.path tracer denoiser motion view.hint: Draws the denoiser's motion debug view; only while it is shown.

pass.path tracer denoiser warp view.label: path tracer warp view
pass.path tracer denoiser warp view.hint: Draws the denoiser's warp debug view; only while it is shown.

pass.path tracer display.label: path tracer display
pass.path tracer display.hint: Shows the path-traced image on the screen; rises with the render size.

pass.card capture clear.label: card capture clear
pass.card capture clear.hint: Clears the surface cache cards about to be captured; rises with the cards captured.

pass.card capture cull.label: card capture cull
pass.card capture cull.hint: Culls the meshes against the cards about to be captured; rises with the cards and the meshes.

pass.card capture raster.label: card capture raster
pass.card capture raster.hint: Draws the meshes into the cards' captures; rises with the triangles captured.

pass.card capture export.label: card capture export
pass.card capture export.hint: Writes the captured cards into the surface cache's atlas; rises with the cards captured.

pass.surface cache atlas clear.label: surface cache atlas clear
pass.surface cache atlas clear.hint: Clears the surface cache atlas's layers; when the atlas is made or reset.

pass.surface cache feedback table argume.label: surface cache feedback arguments
pass.surface cache feedback table argume.hint: Prepares the dispatch of the surface cache's feedback table; a small fixed cost.

pass.surface cache feedback table.label: surface cache feedback table
pass.surface cache feedback table.hint: Builds the table of the cards the image asked for; rises with the cards seen.

pass.surface cache feedback compaction.label: surface cache feedback compaction
pass.surface cache feedback compaction.hint: Compacts the cards the image asked for into a list; rises with the cards seen.

pass.surface cache atlas view.label: surface cache atlas view
pass.surface cache atlas view.hint: Draws the surface cache's atlas debug view; only while it is shown.

pass.inspection reflections.label: inspection reflections
pass.inspection reflections.hint: Traces the reflection rays the inspection draws; only while it is shown.

tab.why.label: Why
tab.why.hint: Why each image was drawn or held, what moved, how far the main view has settled, and what the instruments cost; the engine records it while the panel is open.

summary.still.label: Still view
summary.still.hint: Every frame of the last second held its image: nothing was drawn, so nothing was timed.

summary.stillValue.label: nothing drawn
summary.stillValue.hint: 'Measure the still pose' draws every still image again while on, so its cost is timed.

summary.stillMeasured.label: still measured
summary.stillMeasured.hint: The still pose is measured: every image the view would hold is drawn again (reason forced).

summary.paused.label: paused
summary.paused.hint: The display is paused: the figures stay as they stood, the instruments read on.

detail.median.label: p50 {p50} ms = {n} × {refresh} ms
detail.median.hint: The median interval on the display's grid: whole refreshes times the refresh.

detail.held.label: held {n}
detail.held.hint: Frames of the window that drew no image.

detail.stutters.label: stutters {n}
detail.stutters.hint: Intervals past 50 ms and twice the median.

detail.samples.label: sampled {n} · dropped {d}
detail.samples.hint: The images the GPU timer sampled over the window, and the samples given up unread.

detail.gpuClock.label: GPU timer {us} µs
detail.gpuClock.hint: The GPU timer's step, found from its timestamps.

detail.cpuClock.label: CPU clock {us} µs
detail.cpuClock.hint: The CPU clock's step: 5 µs cross-origin isolated, else 100 µs.

why.strip.label: Images
why.strip.hint: One cell per image of the main view on the graph's time axis, each under the point of its quarter second, coloured by its verdict; a top mark on an image the still pose's measurement forced, a foot mark on one that names a cause. Point at a cell to name that image, and to read a recent one in the Why tab.

why.forced.label: forced
why.forced.hint: An image drawn again by the still pose's measurement.

why.caused.label: causes
why.caused.hint: An image that names what moved since the view kept one.

why.roles.label: Images by view
why.roles.hint: The images read since the window was reset, by the view's role: the main view, the page's views, the engine's own (a mirror, the custom depth, a sky face), a capture.

why.frames.label: Frames read
why.frames.hint: The first and last image the reader recorded since the window was reset, by the record's own numbers.

why.verdicts.label: Verdicts
why.verdicts.hint: What became of the chosen view's images: drawn, or held and why; a verdict no image had is greyed.

why.reasons.label: Unsettled
why.reasons.hint: The work still unsettled when the hold decided, over the images (an image may name several); a name no image had is greyed.

why.terms.label: Every-image terms
why.terms.hint: The term that drew a quiet view again, over the images it drew; a term no image had is greyed.

why.causes.label: Causes
why.causes.hint: What moved a revision or asked an image, over the images (an image may name several); a cause no image had is greyed.

why.sinceChange.label: Since the change
why.sinceChange.hint: Images since the main view last changed, against the images its temporal history takes to forget the view before; greyed when the last window compared none (a view moving or held).

why.history.label: History
why.history.hint: Images the temporal history accumulated, against the images it fills with at the end of the jitter's cycle; greyed when the last window compared none.

why.panelCost.label: Panel, ms a second
why.panelCost.hint: The panel's own main-thread time reading and drawing over the last second, ms per second.

why.instrumentCpu.label: Instruments, CPU
why.instrumentCpu.hint: The time instrument's own main-thread time per frame (its rows, its samples, its reads): the CPU tab's Instruments row.

why.instrumentGpu.label: Instruments, GPU
why.instrumentGpu.hint: The GPU passes the instruments add per frame (the diagnostic stage): the GPU tab's Instruments row.

verdict.drawn.label: drawn
verdict.drawn.hint: A new image was drawn and shown.

verdict.still.label: still
verdict.still.hint: Held: the image before, shown again to the bit.

verdict.heldOnAnswer.label: heldOnAnswer
verdict.heldOnAnswer.hint: Held on an answer the device still owes: a program compiling, a buffer.

verdict.targetsAwaited.label: targetsAwaited
verdict.targetsAwaited.hint: Held on targets the device has not granted yet.

verdict.swapped.label: swapped
verdict.swapped.hint: Drawn into targets made aside and swapped in.

verdict.noiseFinal.label: noiseFinal
verdict.noiseFinal.hint: The last image of a view's establishment, drawn at the noise's canonical phase before the view holds.

verdict.withheld.label: withheld
verdict.withheld.hint: Drawn and not shown: before the view has loaded, or while a load waits on slow streaming.

image.frame.label: Image
image.frame.hint: The image the rows below read: the one under the pointer on the strip, else the last; its session's image number.

image.view.label: View
image.view.hint: The view's role and its place among the views of that role.

image.because.label: Drawn because
image.because.hint: The one reason the hold drew it by; none for a held image.

image.reasons.label: Unsettled
image.reasons.hint: The work still unsettled when the hold decided.

image.term.label: Term
image.term.hint: The term that draws a quiet view every image and drew this one.

image.causes.label: Causes
image.causes.hint: What moved since the view kept an image, by origin.

image.answer.label: Held on
image.answer.hint: The answer the image was held on; none for a drawn image.

image.retryInMs.label: Retry in
image.retryInMs.hint: Held on targets refused: the milliseconds before the refused size is asked again.

image.intervalMs.label: Interval
image.intervalMs.hint: The time the image stayed on screen.

image.refreshes.label: Refreshes
image.refreshes.hint: The whole display refreshes the image stayed on screen.

image.bound.label: Bound by
image.bound.hint: What set its refreshes: the GPU, the CPU or the display's pacing.

bound.gpu.label: GPU
bound.gpu.hint: The graphics processor's time set it.

bound.cpu.label: CPU
bound.cpu.hint: The main thread's time set it.

bound.pacing.label: display pacing
bound.pacing.hint: Neither processor: the display's refresh, the page or a frame cap set it.

image.gpuMs.label: GPU
image.gpuMs.hint: The image's GPU time; none when the timer did not sample it.

image.outsideMs.label: Outside the image
image.outsideMs.hint: The GPU work submitted beside the image in its frame.

image.waitMs.label: Wait
image.waitMs.hint: The interval less the busier processor: time waiting for a refresh.

image.toNextRefreshMs.label: One refresh sooner
image.toNextRefreshMs.hint: The time the bound processor must give up for the image to land one refresh sooner.

control.every.label: GPU timed
control.every.hint: How often the GPU timer reads an image: 1 in {every} by default, the lightest; 1 in 3 or every image times more of them, each at a timer query and a readback.

control.everyImage.label: every image
control.everyImage.hint: Every image is timed on the GPU: the most samples, at a timer query and a readback each image.

control.still.label: Measure the still pose
control.still.hint: While on, every image the view would hold is drawn again, so the still pose is timed; each such image is a new TAA sample (reason forced). It costs a whole image each frame.

control.pause.label: Pause display
control.pause.hint: Freezes the figures shown; the instruments read on, and the strip still answers the pointer.

control.reset.label: Reset window
control.reset.hint: Forgets the images and counts read so far: the window starts again now.

control.export.label: Download JSON
control.export.hint: The why and time instruments' windows of the last minute, as the engine gave them, each time window with the options its reader was opened with; the page's address, the world read, the readers' state and what was asked.

control.role.label: View counted
control.role.hint: Which view's images this tab counts: the main view, the page's views, the engine's own (a mirror, a sky face), a capture; among the roles read.

control.world.label: World
control.world.hint: The page's world the panel reads, by its place among the page's worlds (the first made is the main view); every window starts again on the one chosen.

control.view.label: View
control.view.hint: What the world draws: the render, or a view of how the engine works (`world.diagnostic.mode`); a greyed one is not offered here, or the world refused it.

control.viewUnavailable.label: not drawn here
control.viewUnavailable.hint: This engine build does not draw this view yet.

control.viewRefused.label: refused by this world
control.viewRefused.hint: The world kept the view it had when this one was asked; the console says why.

control.freeze.label: Freeze culling
control.freeze.hint: Holds the cut (its levels, HLOD, frustum and occlusion) at the camera of now while the camera moves on (`world.diagnostic.freeze`): stepping aside in the X-ray view shows what it submitted and what it dropped.

viewGroup.geometry.label: Geometry
viewGroup.geometry.hint: What the cut drew: its triangles, clusters, detail levels, HLOD, voxels, screen error and pages, seen through or counted.

viewGroup.materials.label: Materials
viewGroup.materials.hint: The surfaces' materials: their classes, the properties under the cursor, the texture size read, the subsurface profiles.

viewGroup.lighting.label: Lighting
viewGroup.lighting.hint: The light the surfaces receive, whole or term by term, and the atlases of the lights' pictures and profiles.

viewGroup.temporal.label: Temporal antialiasing
viewGroup.temporal.hint: The temporal accumulation: the image it receives, its history and what rejects it, and what changed from one image to the next.

viewGroup.shadowMaps.label: Shadow maps
viewGroup.shadowMaps.hint: The virtual shadow maps: the levels and pages each pixel reads, their cache, their casters and their cost.

viewGroup.surfaceCache.label: Surface cache
viewGroup.surfaceCache.hint: The atlas of the meshes' cards, its light updates, and the scene seen through its light.

viewGroup.probes.label: Probes
viewGroup.probes.hint: The screen probes, the world's probes and the reflection rays: where they stand, what they trace, what they hold.

viewGroup.sampledLights.label: Sampled lights
viewGroup.sampledLights.hint: The sampled lighting of many lights: the surfaces its shadow rays meet, and what each pixel costs.

viewGroup.hair.label: Hair
viewGroup.hair.hint: The hair strands: their bounds, deep shadows, screen frames and voxels.

viewGroup.volumes.label: Volumes
viewGroup.volumes.hint: The heterogeneous volumes' voxel grids, by each way of finding the transmittance through them.

viewGroup.other.label: Other
viewGroup.other.hint: Views no group of the panel names yet.

reader.waiting.label: waiting for world {n}
reader.waiting.hint: The world chosen has drawn no frame since: the figures shown are the world before until it draws one.

reader.missing.label: not in this build: {names}
reader.missing.hint: This engine build has no such instrument; nothing of it is shown.

reader.failed.label: failed
reader.failed.hint: An instrument's reader did not open (its family did not load).

reader.faulted.label: faulted: {message}
reader.faulted.hint: A read or a draw of the panel threw; it reads on.

gpu.outside.label: Outside the image
gpu.outside.hint: Work the engine submits beside the images (texture tiles, pages installed, sky captures), timed while the time is read.

gpu.diagnostic.label: Instruments
gpu.diagnostic.hint: Passes a view or an inspection adds to show how the engine works; not the engine's own cost.

gpu.views.label: Views beside the main one
gpu.views.hint: Each view drawn beside the main image (a page view, a mirror, the custom depth, a sky face): its mean GPU time over its own images, summed; not part of the frame above.

cpu.diagnostic.label: Instruments
cpu.diagnostic.hint: The frame time instrument's own main-thread work per frame while it is read (its rows, its samples, its reads); not the engine's cost.

control.everyN.label: 1 in {n}
control.everyN.hint: One image in {n} is timed on the GPU.

control.actions.label: Actions
control.actions.hint: What the display does with what is read: pause it, start the window again, download it.

role.planarReflection.label: planar reflection
role.planarReflection.hint: A planar mirror's view, drawn beside the main one.

role.customDepth.label: custom depth
role.customDepth.hint: The custom depth view, drawn beside the main one.

role.skyFace.label: sky face
role.skyFace.hint: A face of the sky meshes' cube, drawn beside the main one.

role.aside.label: capture
role.aside.hint: A view drawn aside: a capture.

gpu.surfaceCache.label: Surface cache
gpu.surfaceCache.hint: Capturing the cards of the meshes into the atlas the rays read; rises with the pages captured in an image.

shadows.pagesEmpty.label: Shadow pages empty
shadows.pagesEmpty.hint: Pool pages holding nothing, free for the next grant; rises when the shadows ask for less.

shadows.pagesWpoConsidered.label: Shadow pages with offsets
shadows.pagesWpoConsidered.hint: Cached shadow pages kept under the cull of the offsets allowed on them; rises with the offset materials in view.

shadows.rootsNoted.label: Placements moved
shadows.rootsNoted.hint: Running total of placement worlds noted moved; its rise per image is the placements a move reached.

shadows.rootsBoxed.label: Root boxes derived
shadows.rootsBoxed.hint: Running total of root boxes the roots pass derived; the shadow invalidation sees a placement through them.

pass.cluster measure.label: cluster measure
pass.cluster measure.hint: Measures the longest edge of the clusters whose pages arrived; rises with the pages that arrive.

pass.raster depth export.label: raster depth export
pass.raster depth export.hint: Writes the scene's depth attachment from the depth pyramid's first level; rises with the render size.

pass.material bins and shading.label: material bins and shading
pass.material bins and shading.hint: Sorts pixels by material and shades each material's bin; rises with the materials and pixels in view.

pass.translucency modulation.label: translucency modulation
pass.translucency modulation.hint: Draws the layers that multiply what is behind them; rises with those layers in view.

pass.translucency compose.label: translucency compose
pass.translucency compose.hint: Composes the translucent layers onto the image; rises with the render size.

pass.reflection clear.label: reflection clear
pass.reflection clear.hint: Empties the reflection image where no ray is traced; rises with the render size.

pass.reflection resolve.label: reflection resolve
pass.reflection resolve.hint: Reuses the rays of neighbouring pixels to fill the reflection image; rises with the reflective pixels.

pass.reflection temporal.label: reflection temporal
pass.reflection temporal.hint: Accumulates the reflections of earlier images to clean the image; rises with the reflective pixels.

pass.reflection bilateral.label: reflection bilateral
pass.reflection bilateral.hint: Filters the noisy or new reflections with their neighbours and writes the reflection image; rises with the reflective pixels.

pass.reflection keep depth.label: reflection keep depth
pass.reflection keep depth.hint: Keeps the opaque depth for the next image reflections; rises with the render size.

pass.tile classification.label: tile classification
pass.tile classification.hint: Sorts the screen tiles by the kind of surface they hold, so that each is lit by the program it needs; rises with the render size.

pass.surface colour.label: surface colour
pass.surface colour.hint: Writes every pixel's first colour: the background, the surfaces shown as they are and the emission; rises with the render size.

pass.sun light.label: sun light
pass.sun light.hint: Adds the sun's and the other directional lights, with their shadows, to the surfaces; rises with the lit pixels and the lights.

pass.local lights.label: local lights
pass.local lights.hint: Adds the lamps of each pixel's cell of the light grid to the surfaces; rises with the lit pixels and the lights that reach them.

pass.indirect light.label: indirect light
pass.indirect light.hint: Adds the environment's and the sky's light, the bounced light, the reflections and a thin surface's back; rises with the lit pixels.

pass.height fog.label: height fog
pass.height fog.hint: Lays the fog, the local fog volumes and the haze of the air over the lit image; rises with the render size.

pass.temporal dilate velocity.label: temporal dilate velocity
pass.temporal dilate velocity.hint: Finds each pixel's closest surface and its motion for the temporal antialiasing; rises with the render size.

pass.temporal decimate history.label: temporal decimate history
pass.temporal decimate history.hint: Reprojects the earlier images' small histories onto this image; rises with the render size.

pass.temporal detect thin geometry.label: temporal detect thin geometry
pass.temporal detect thin geometry.hint: Finds the thin geometry the history must keep; rises with the render size.

pass.temporal reject shading.label: temporal reject shading
pass.temporal reject shading.hint: After measuring which pixels flicker from one image to the next, measures where the history no longer matches the image and must be dropped; rises with the render size.

pass.temporal spatial anti aliasing.label: temporal spatial anti-aliasing
pass.temporal spatial anti aliasing.hint: Smooths the edges of the pixels whose history was dropped; rises with the render size.

pass.temporal update history.label: temporal update history
pass.temporal update history.hint: Blends the image into the history to smooth the edges; rises with the history size.

pass.temporal resolve history.label: temporal resolve history
pass.temporal resolve history.hint: Brings a history larger than the display down to it; rises with the display size.

pass.temporal resolve display layers.label: temporal resolve display layers
pass.temporal resolve display layers.hint: Brings the display layers' history down to the display; rises with the display size.

control.details.label: Details
control.details.hint: Opens the details window over the view: the frame as a diagram, every stage and pass, why each image was drawn, the last minutes, memory and scene. While it is open the GPU is timed on every image unless you chose another sampling; closed, it costs nothing.

details.label.label: Engine details
details.label.hint: Everything the instruments read of the engine, tab by tab; Esc or × closes it.

tab.overview.label: Overview
tab.overview.hint: The frame as a diagram: each GPU stage a bar as long as its time, the CPU under it, the refresh budget a line; what holds the frame said in words. Click a stage to open its rows.

tab.history.label: History
tab.history.hint: The last five minutes, one point a second: the image's, the GPU's and the CPU's time, the seconds that stuttered and the ones whose images named a cause.

stageGroup.scene.label: World
stageGroup.scene.hint: What moves the world: physics, animations, lights.

stageGroup.cut.label: Cut and streaming
stageGroup.cut.hint: What the engine chooses to draw and brings to the GPU: the cut, the pages, the uploads, the textures.

stageGroup.commands.label: Commands
stageGroup.commands.hint: Recording and sending the GPU commands.

stageGroup.surfaces.label: Surfaces
stageGroup.surfaces.hint: Drawing the surfaces: the depth pyramid, the geometry, the decals and the transparents.

stageGroup.light.label: Light
stageGroup.light.hint: Lighting the surfaces: the surface cache, the shadows, the light lists, the bounce, the reflections and the lighting.

stageGroup.image.label: Image
stageGroup.image.hint: Finishing the image: antialiasing, effects and the present.

stageGroup.apart.label: Apart
stageGroup.apart.hint: GPU work outside the image, the instruments’ own, and passes no stage declares.

overview.said.label: The image takes {frame} ms, the GPU {gpu} ms, the CPU {cpu} ms; it waits {wait} ms on a {budget} ms refresh.
overview.said.hint: The frame in one sentence while nothing tells what holds it yet: the processors' times and the wait for the display.

overview.said.gpu.label: Limited by the GPU — the image takes {frame} ms, the GPU {gpu} ms, the CPU {cpu} ms; it waits {wait} ms on a {budget} ms refresh.
overview.said.gpu.hint: The frame in one sentence: the GPU's time set how many refreshes an image stays on screen; then the processors' times and the wait for the display.

overview.said.cpu.label: Limited by the CPU — the image takes {frame} ms, the GPU {gpu} ms, the CPU {cpu} ms; it waits {wait} ms on a {budget} ms refresh.
overview.said.cpu.hint: The frame in one sentence: the main thread's time set how many refreshes an image stays on screen; then the processors' times and the wait for the display.

overview.said.pacing.label: Limited by the display's pacing — the image takes {frame} ms, the GPU {gpu} ms, the CPU {cpu} ms; it waits {wait} ms on a {budget} ms refresh.
overview.said.pacing.hint: The frame in one sentence: neither processor set how many refreshes an image stays on screen, the display's refresh, the page or a frame cap did; then the processors' times and the wait for the display.

overview.unread.label: No time read yet
overview.unread.hint: The GPU and CPU stages appear once the frame time reader has read a second.

overview.stage.label: {name}: {ms} ms · {share} % of the image
overview.stage.hint: A stage of the frame, its mean time over the last second and its share of the GPU's image; click to open its rows.

table.name.label: Name
table.name.hint: The stage, and its passes under it; click to sort in the pipeline order.

table.avg.label: Avg
table.avg.hint: Mean over the last second; coloured against the refresh budget: orange past a quarter, red past a half. Click to sort.

table.p95.label: p95
table.p95.hint: The 95th percentile over the last second: 1 image in 20 takes longer. Click to sort.

table.max.label: Max
table.max.hint: The longest over the last second. Click to sort.

table.share.label: % of image
table.share.hint: Share of the GPU's image (or the CPU's frame). Click to sort.

table.trend.label: Last minute
table.trend.hint: The mean of each second over the last minute.

history.stutter.label: stutter
history.stutter.hint: A second with at least one image the display had to wait for longer than its usual cadence: a red mark at the top.

history.cause.label: cause
history.cause.hint: A second whose images named what moved them: a yellow mark at the foot; point at it to read the causes.

history.point.label: {ago} s ago · image {frame} ms (max {max}) · GPU {gpu} ms · CPU {cpu} ms
history.point.hint: The second under the pointer: its mean times and its longest image.

history.unread.label: Nothing read yet
history.unread.hint: One point a second from what the frame time reader reads, whatever the panel shows: the first comes after a second.

history.zoom.label: from {from} s to {to} s ago · double-click: the last five minutes
history.zoom.hint: Drag across the chart to zoom on a span; double-click to see the last five minutes again.

history.clipped.label: ▲ past the scale
history.clipped.hint: A small triangle at the chart's top edge, in a line's colour: that second's time passed the scale's top, a spike the scale leaves out; point at it to read it whole.

pass.material bins.label: material bins
pass.material bins.hint: Sorts the pixels into one bin per material class before each class shades its own; rises with the render size.

pass.material shading.label: material shading
pass.material shading.hint: One material class shading its bin's pixels, each decoding its own triangle; rises with the pixels of that class.

pass.blend responsiveness.label: blend responsiveness
pass.blend responsiveness.hint: Marks where the transparents ask the temporal filter to follow them faster; rises with the transparent pixels.

pass.alpha holdout start.label: alpha holdout start
pass.alpha holdout start.hint: Starts the holdout target from the lit image's alpha; rises with the render size.

pass.blend alpha holdout.label: blend alpha holdout
pass.blend alpha holdout.hint: Draws the holdout layers into their target; rises with their pixels.

pass.alpha holdout apply.label: alpha holdout apply
pass.alpha holdout apply.hint: Lays the holdout's visibility back over the lit image's alpha; rises with the render size.

pass.translucent radiance mark.label: translucent radiance mark
pass.translucent radiance mark.hint: Marks the radiance cache cells the translucent surfaces read; rises with the translucent pixels.

pass.sorted translucency collect.label: sorted translucency collect
pass.sorted translucency collect.hint: Collects the translucent layers of each pixel for their sort; rises with the layers per pixel.

pass.sorted translucency combine.label: sorted translucency combine
pass.sorted translucency combine.hint: Composes the sorted layers front to back onto the translucency target; rises with the layers per pixel.

pass.water.label: water
pass.water.hint: Shades the single-layer water; rises with the water pixels on screen.

pass.water scene copy.label: water scene copy
pass.water scene copy.hint: Copies the scene without the water for its refraction; rises with the render size.

pass.water depth.label: water depth
pass.water depth.hint: Draws the water's depth; rises with its pixels.

pass.water refraction mask.label: water refraction mask
pass.water refraction mask.hint: Masks what the water may refract; rises with its pixels.

pass.water tiles.label: water tiles
pass.water tiles.hint: Lists the screen tiles that hold water; rises with the render size.

pass.water velocity.label: water velocity
pass.water velocity.hint: Writes the water surface's motion for the temporal filter; rises with its pixels.

pass.water sun shadow.label: water sun shadow
pass.water sun shadow.hint: Shadows the water from the sun; rises with its pixels.

pass.water composite.label: water composite
pass.water composite.hint: Composes the water's reflection and refraction over the image; rises with its pixels.

pass.hzb occlusion roots.label: hzb occlusion roots
pass.hzb occlusion roots.hint: Derives the root boxes' corners for their test against the depth pyramid; rises with the roots.

pass.hardware occlusion boxes.label: hardware occlusion boxes
pass.hardware occlusion boxes.hint: Draws the root boxes against the depth, one occlusion query a group; rises with the boxes tested.

pass.hardware occlusion small depth.label: hardware occlusion small depth
pass.hardware occlusion small depth.hint: Builds the small depth the occlusion boxes are drawn against; rises with the render size.

pass.hardware occlusion verdicts.label: hardware occlusion verdicts
pass.hardware occlusion verdicts.hint: Turns the queries' counts into visible or hidden verdicts; rises with the boxes tested.

pass.surface cache.label: surface cache
pass.surface cache.hint: Updates the surface cache: its cards captured, cleared, fed back and shown; rises with the cards to update.

pass.surface cache lighting.label: surface cache lighting
pass.surface cache lighting.hint: Lights the surface cache's cards the bounce reads; rises with the cards and the lights.

pass.card capture.label: card capture
pass.card capture.hint: Captures the cards of the surface cache from the meshes; rises with the cards captured this image.

pass.screen probes.label: screen probes
pass.screen probes.hint: Places probes on the image, traces, filters and blends them for the bounced light; rises with the render size and the rays.

pass.reflection hit lighting.label: reflection hit lighting
pass.reflection hit lighting.hint: Lights again the reflection rays' hits, sorted by material; rises with the rays that hit.

pass.sky surfaces.label: sky surfaces
pass.sky surfaces.hint: Draws the sky surfaces into the lit image ahead of the atmosphere, the fog and the clouds; rises with the sky pixels.

pass.fog separate composition.label: fog separate composition
pass.fog separate composition.hint: Lays the fog drawn in its own textures over the lit image; rises with the render size.

pass.fog blur.label: fog blur
pass.fog blur.hint: Blurs the fog's own textures; rises with their size.

pass.fog upsample.label: fog upsample
pass.fog upsample.hint: Brings the fog's textures back up to the image; rises with the render size.

pass.fog temporal.label: fog temporal
pass.fog temporal.hint: Filters the fog's second level over time; rises with its size.

pass.fog volume.label: fog volume
pass.fog volume.hint: Builds the fog's volume: the depth of its cells, the light each scatters, the sum along each column; rises with the cells and the lights.

pass.fog local volumes.label: fog local volumes
pass.fog local volumes.hint: Draws the local fog volumes; rises with the volumes on screen.

pass.fog sun light function.label: fog sun light function
pass.fog sun light function.hint: Draws the sun's light function for the volumetric fog; rises with its size.

pass.light function atlas.label: light function atlas
pass.light function atlas.hint: Draws the lights' light functions into their atlas; rises with the lights that have one.

pass.toon profile bake.label: toon profile bake
pass.toon profile bake.hint: Bakes a toon profile's images into the patterns the lights read; runs when a profile changes.

pass.rect light atlas add.label: rect light atlas add
pass.rect light atlas add.hint: Draws a rectangle light's source picture into its atlas; runs when one is added.

pass.rect light atlas copy.label: rect light atlas copy
pass.rect light atlas copy.hint: Moves a rectangle light's slot to a new atlas; runs when the atlas grows.

pass.rect light atlas filter.label: rect light atlas filter
pass.rect light atlas filter.hint: Filters a level of the rectangle lights' atlas; runs when a picture changes.

pass.rect light atlas clear.label: rect light atlas clear
pass.rect light atlas clear.hint: Clears the rectangle lights' atlas; runs when it is made again.

pass.rect light atlas debug.label: rect light atlas debug
pass.rect light atlas debug.hint: Draws the rectangle lights' atlas for its debug view; only while that view is shown.

pass.rect light atlas blit.label: rect light atlas blit
pass.rect light atlas blit.hint: Lays the rectangle lights' atlas over the image for its debug view; only while that view is shown.

pass.light profile atlas debug.label: light profile atlas debug
pass.light profile atlas debug.hint: Draws the light profiles' atlas for its debug view; only while that view is shown.

pass.light profile atlas blit.label: light profile atlas blit
pass.light profile atlas blit.hint: Lays the light profiles' atlas over the image for its debug view; only while that view is shown.

pass.light shapes.label: light shapes
pass.light shapes.hint: Draws the lights' shapes as wireframes over the lit image; only while they are shown.

pass.volumetric lightmap light.label: volumetric lightmap light
pass.volumetric lightmap light.hint: Gathers the volumetric lightmap's light on the pixels before the indirect light reads it; rises with the render size.

pass.volumetric lightmap visualize.label: volumetric lightmap visualize
pass.volumetric lightmap visualize.hint: Draws a sphere for each sample of the volumetric lightmap; only while that view is shown.

pass.translucency volume.label: translucency volume
pass.translucency volume.hint: Injects every light into the cells around the camera that the see-through surfaces are lit from; rises with the lights.
