pass.translucency volume spheres.label: translucency volume spheres
pass.translucency volume spheres.hint: Draws a sphere for each cell of the translucency volume; only while that view is shown.

pass.translucency global illumination.label: translucency global illumination
pass.translucency global illumination.hint: Traces and filters the indirect light of the see-through surfaces into a grid fitted to the view; rises with its cells.

pass.traced translucency trace.label: traced translucency trace
pass.traced translucency trace.hint: Traces rays through the see-through surfaces; rises with their pixels.

pass.traced translucency denoise.label: traced translucency denoise
pass.traced translucency denoise.hint: Denoises the see-through surfaces' traced rays; rises with their pixels.

pass.traced translucency compose.label: traced translucency compose
pass.traced translucency compose.hint: Composes the traced see-through surfaces onto the lit image; rises with their pixels.

pass.ambient occlusion.label: ambient occlusion
pass.ambient occlusion.hint: Finds how hidden each pixel is from its surroundings, at several resolutions; rises with the render size.

pass.subsurface scattering.label: subsurface scattering
pass.subsurface scattering.hint: Spreads the light under the skin-like surfaces; rises with their pixels.

pass.responsiveness clear.label: responsiveness clear
pass.responsiveness clear.hint: Clears the responsiveness the blends write and the temporal filter reads; rises with the render size.

pass.velocity.label: velocity
pass.velocity.hint: Writes the motion of every pixel for the passes that read it; rises with the render size.

pass.temporal measure flickering luma.label: temporal measure flickering luma
pass.temporal measure flickering luma.hint: Measures where the brightness flickers from image to image; rises with the render size.

pass.temporal measure thin geometry cove.label: temporal measure thin geometry coverage
pass.temporal measure thin geometry cove.hint: Measures how much of each pixel thin geometry covers; rises with the render size.

pass.temporal thin geometry weight relax.label: temporal thin geometry weight relaxation
pass.temporal thin geometry weight relax.hint: Relaxes the history's weight where thin geometry stands; rises with the render size.

pass.tone table.label: tone table
pass.tone table.hint: Bakes the colour the display shows for every light into a small cube the composition reads; runs when the tone settings change.

pass.motion blur.label: motion blur
pass.motion blur.hint: Blurs along the motion of the pixels: its tiles, their spread and the filter; rises with the render size and the motion.

pass.depth of field.label: depth of field
pass.depth of field.hint: Blurs what is out of focus: its circles, tiles, gathers and sprites; rises with the render size and the blur.

pass.post process material.label: post process material
pass.post process material.hint: Runs a post-process material over the whole image; rises with the render size and the material's work.

pass.custom depth.label: custom depth
pass.custom depth.hint: Writes the custom depth and stencil of the objects that ask for them; rises with those objects.

pass.page install.label: page install
pass.page install.hint: Installs geometry pages just loaded on the device; rises with the pages arriving.

pass.ray query.label: ray query
pass.ray query.hint: Answers the page's picking rays on the GPU; rises with the rays asked.

pass.hair strands.label: hair strands
pass.hair strands.hint: Any pass of the hair strands: their simulation, shadows, voxels and drawing; rises with the strands.

pass.sun distance field shadow.label: sun distance field shadow
pass.sun distance field shadow.hint: Traces the sun's far shadows through the distance fields; rises with the render size.

pass.distance field occlusion.label: distance field occlusion
pass.distance field occlusion.hint: Traces the ambient occlusion through the distance fields; rises with the render size.

pass.global distance field.label: global distance field
pass.global distance field.hint: Builds the global distance field the traces read; rises with the meshes that move.

pass.mesh distance field.label: mesh distance field
pass.mesh distance field.hint: Builds a mesh's own distance field; runs when a mesh needs one.

pass.path tracer.label: path tracer
pass.path tracer.hint: Any pass of the path tracer: its samples, tables and display; rises with the samples a pixel.

pass.air.label: air
pass.air.hint: Builds the atmosphere's lookup tables; rises with the sun's moves.

pass.sky.label: sky
pass.sky.hint: Draws the sky over the image, captures the sky light and filters it; rises with the sky pixels and its captures.

pass.opaque haze.label: opaque haze
pass.opaque haze.hint: Lays the atmosphere's haze over the opaque surfaces; rises with the render size.

pass.cloud.label: cloud
pass.cloud.hint: Any pass of the volumetric clouds; rises with the cloud pixels and their steps.

pass.light shafts.label: light shafts
pass.light shafts.hint: Draws the light shafts of the sun; rises with the render size.

pass.surface rewrite.label: surface rewrite
pass.surface rewrite.hint: Rewrites the surfaces the sky and the fog change; rises with the render size.

pass.debug lines appended.label: debug lines appended
pass.debug lines appended.hint: Appends the lines of a debug view; only while that view is shown.

pass.inspection reflection.label: inspection reflection
pass.inspection reflection.hint: The inspection's reflection kernels; only while an inspection is open.

reason.lost.label: device lost
reason.lost.hint: The GPU device was lost: the image is drawn again once it is back.

reason.capturing.label: capturing
reason.capturing.hint: A capture is under way: its images are drawn.

reason.capturePending.label: capture asked
reason.capturePending.hint: A capture was asked and waits for its image.

reason.frameEncoder.label: frame encoder
reason.frameEncoder.hint: The frame's commands are still being recorded: the image cannot be kept yet.

reason.metricsPending.label: metrics pending
reason.metricsPending.hint: The last image's counts have not come back from the GPU yet.

reason.cutMoving.label: cut moving
reason.cutMoving.hint: The cut of the geometry is still changing.

reason.overBudget.label: over budget
reason.overBudget.hint: The cut wants more than its budget allows: it keeps refining.

reason.noOccluderHistory.label: no occluder history
reason.noOccluderHistory.hint: The occlusion test has no last image to test against yet.

reason.deferredDrops.label: drops deferred
reason.deferredDrops.hint: Geometry the cut let go is still waiting to be dropped.

reason.bootstrap.label: starting
reason.bootstrap.hint: The view is in its first images.

reason.residencyBusy.label: pages loading
reason.residencyBusy.hint: Geometry pages are still loading or installing.

reason.clustersOwed.label: clusters owed
reason.clustersOwed.hint: Clusters the cut asked for have not been drawn yet.

reason.texturesPending.label: textures pending
reason.texturesPending.hint: Texture tiles the view asked for are still loading.

reason.shadowsPending.label: shadows pending
reason.shadowsPending.hint: Shadow pages the view needs are not all drawn yet.

reason.cutPending.label: cut pending
reason.cutPending.hint: A new cut is asked and not yet adopted.

reason.bounceProbes.label: bounce probes
reason.bounceProbes.hint: The bounced light's probes are still converging.

reason.deforming.label: deforming
reason.deforming.hint: Geometry is being deformed this image.

reason.hlodWarming.label: HLOD warming
reason.hlodWarming.hint: HLOD levels are still being prepared.

reason.exposure.label: exposure
reason.exposure.hint: The automatic exposure is still adapting.

reason.fogVolume.label: fog volume
reason.fogVolume.hint: The fog's volume is still converging.

reason.translucencyVolume.label: translucency volume
reason.translucencyVolume.hint: The translucency lighting volume is still converging.

reason.translucencyGi.label: translucency GI
reason.translucencyGi.hint: The see-through surfaces' indirect light is still converging.

reason.screenProbes.label: screen probes
reason.screenProbes.hint: The screen probes are still converging.

reason.occlusion.label: occlusion
reason.occlusion.hint: The occlusion verdicts are still settling.

reason.casterSettling.label: shadow casters settling
reason.casterSettling.hint: Shadow casters moved recently: their shadows are still settling.

reason.noisePhase.label: noise phase
reason.noisePhase.hint: The image is one of the noise phases the temporal history needs to settle.

term.taaConverging.label: TAA converging
term.taaConverging.hint: The temporal antialiasing has not gathered its history yet: each image is drawn till it has.

term.frameDifference.label: frame difference
term.frameDifference.hint: The frame difference view draws every image to compare it with the one before.

term.surfaceCache.label: surface cache
term.surfaceCache.hint: The surface cache is updating its cards.

term.pathTracing.label: path tracing
term.pathTracing.hint: The path tracer adds samples every image.

term.guides.label: guides
term.guides.hint: Animated guides are drawn over the image.

term.hairDebug.label: hair debug
term.hairDebug.hint: A hair debug view is shown.

term.fogSunLightFunction.label: fog's sun light function
term.fogSunLightFunction.hint: The sun's light function in the fog animates.

answer.device refusal.label: device refusal
answer.device refusal.hint: The device refused the work: the image waits until it is asked again.

answer.targets in flight.label: targets in flight
answer.targets in flight.hint: The targets of the last image are still in use by the GPU.

answer.lit program.label: lit program
answer.lit program.hint: The lit image's program is still compiling.

answer.sorted translucency buffers.label: sorted translucency buffers
answer.sorted translucency buffers.hint: The sorted translucency's buffers are still being made.

answer.translucent object shadow table.label: translucent shadow table
answer.translucent object shadow table.hint: The translucent objects' shadow table is still being made.

answer.targets refused.label: targets refused
answer.targets refused.hint: The device refused the targets' size; it is asked again after a delay.

because.scene.label: scene changed
because.scene.hint: Something of the scene moved since the image kept.

because.view.label: view changed
because.view.hint: The view moved since the image kept.

because.resources.label: resources changed
because.resources.hint: A resource the image reads changed since the image kept.

because.confirming.label: confirming
because.confirming.hint: The image after a change, drawn once more to confirm it.

because.unstable.label: unstable
because.unstable.hint: The last two images' work differed.

because.swapped.label: swapped
because.swapped.hint: A quiet image drawn into targets swapped in.

because.forced.label: forced
because.forced.hint: The still pose's measurement asked it.

cause.sceneWritten.label: scene written
cause.sceneWritten.hint: The page wrote a pose, a visibility or a light of the scene.

cause.sceneReshaped.label: scene reshaped
cause.sceneReshaped.hint: The page added, removed or moved a node.

cause.fogVolumes.label: fog volumes
cause.fogVolumes.hint: The page set the fog volumes.

cause.cameraCut.label: camera cut
cause.cameraCut.hint: Another camera, or a cut of the view history.

cause.viewMoved.label: view moved
cause.viewMoved.hint: The view's pose, projection or viewport changed.

cause.viewQuality.label: view quality
cause.viewQuality.hint: The view's depth range or quality changed.

cause.skyFaceWaiting.label: sky face waiting
cause.skyFaceWaiting.hint: A face of the sky cube waits to be drawn.

cause.targetsMade.label: targets made
cause.targetsMade.hint: The image targets were made again.

cause.taaRigged.label: TAA rigged
cause.taaRigged.hint: The temporal antialiasing was set up again.

cause.feedbackVariant.label: feedback variant
cause.feedbackVariant.hint: The texture feedback changed its variant.

cause.cutReleased.label: cut released
cause.cutReleased.hint: Geometry of the cut was released.

cause.cutAdopted.label: cut adopted
cause.cutAdopted.hint: A new cut of the geometry was adopted.

cause.cutFrozen.label: cut frozen
cause.cutFrozen.hint: The cut was frozen or let go.

cause.coverPending.label: cover pending
cause.coverPending.hint: A cover waits to be drawn.

cause.shadowSetLost.label: shadow set lost

viewHints.triangles: One solid colour per triangle drawn.
viewHints.xray: The edges of every triangle the engine submitted, seen through walls: what culling dropped is gone. Freeze culling, then step aside to check.
viewHints.clusters: One colour per cluster, the group of triangles the cut swaps for a coarser one.
viewHints.lod: Detail level drawn — blue: full detail, then cyan, green, yellow, red as it gets coarser (red: 8 levels and more).
viewHints.hlod: White: the object itself, near. Blue: HLOD 0, the cell's objects batched. Yellow, purple, cyan: HLOD 1, 2, 3, one simple shell per cell, coarser at each level.
viewHints.screen-error: Green: exact. Yellow: near the allowed pixel error. Red: at it.
viewHints.materials: One colour per kind of material.
viewHints.visibility: Green: every page drawn this frame.
viewHints.frame-difference: Black: the pixel did not change since the last frame. Grey to white: it changed, eight times amplified — whatever flickers lights up.
viewHints.reflections: Only the light the surfaces reflect, from the screen trace and the probes; black where nothing is reflected.
viewHints.shadows: How much sunlight reaches each surface — white: lit, black: in shadow. No material colour.
viewHints.lighting: All the light on a white surface: direct, reflected, bounced and ambient. No material colour.
viewHints.no-temporal-aa: The normal image without temporal accumulation: the raw image of this frame, its aliasing and noise included.
viewHints.taa-input: The image the temporal AA receives, jitter on, nothing accumulated: each pixel shows the rendered pixel it falls in — it shimmers from frame to frame.
viewHints.taa-rejection: How much history each pixel keeps — white: history kept, black: rejected (a change of shading, off screen).
viewHints.taa-validity: How much history each pixel holds after the update — white: a full history, black: it starts again. Grey: still converging.
viewHints.taa-flicker: The flicker measure — red: its error, green: how many flickers it counted, blue: the transparents' coverage that cancels it.
viewHints.taa-shading: The shading rejection, white: history kept — red: without the flicker widening, green: with it, blue: spread to the neighbours, what the update applies.
viewHints.taa-reprojection: Why the history restarts — red: disoccluded, green: disoccluded and filled with the occluder's motion, blue: off the last screen.
viewHints.taa-motion: The motion the accumulation sees — red: moving for the flicker measure, green: a pixel animation, blue: the reprojection edge (white: flat motion).
viewHints.taa-thin: Thin geometry — red: how far the history clamp relaxes, green: a cluster hole region, blue: the coverage history.
viewHints.taa-material-history: Each material's share of history as grey — white: 1, the full smoothing; black: 0, the current image alone.
viewHints.voxels: What is drawn as voxels, one colour per level; the triangles in grey.
viewHints.indirect-diffuse: Only the indirect light (bounces, environment, sky) on a mid-grey surface.
viewHints.surface-cache-albedo: The atlas of the surface cards: the colour they captured.
viewHints.surface-cache-normal: The atlas: the normals the cards captured.
viewHints.surface-cache-depth: The atlas: each texel's depth in its card, as grey.
viewHints.surface-cache-cards: The atlas: one colour per card.
viewHints.surface-cache-fill: The atlas: green the coarsest level always kept, blue finer pages, black free.
viewHints.surface-cache-age: The atlas: images since each page was captured, white new, blue old.
viewHints.hair-light-bounds: The hair strands' boxes and shadow frusta over the image.
viewHints.hair-deep-opacity-maps: A hair deep shadow map's depth and layers over the image.
viewHints.hair-macro-group-screen-rect: A green frame around the pixels each group of strands covers.
viewHints.hair-voxels-density: How many strands each pixel's ray crosses, green to red.
viewHints.sampled-lights-overview: The shadow casters view and the caster quality view side by side.
viewHints.sampled-lights-shadow-casters: What the shadow rays hit at each pixel, one colour per object.
viewHints.sampled-lights-shadow-caster-quality: Red: a shadow caster missing; blue: one in front of the surface.
viewHints.sampled-lights-complexity-opaque: The lights of the cell under the cursor, and a heat map of their sampling cost.
viewHints.sampled-lights-complexity-hair-strands: The lights' sampling cost on hair strands.
viewHints.sampled-lights-complexity-front-layer: The lights on the nearest transparent layer, and a heat map of their cost.
viewHints.sampled-lights-complexity-volume: The lights' sampling cost in the fog volume.
viewHints.sampled-lights-complexity-translucency-v: The lights' sampling cost in the translucency lighting volume.
viewHints.subsurface-profiles: Each pixel's subsurface profile, one colour per profile.
viewHints.virtual-shadow-map-shadow-casters: The box of every object whose movement redraws shadow pages.
viewHints.virtual-shadow-map-clipmap-virtual-space: The sun's shadow clipmap in its virtual space.
viewHints.virtual-shadow-map-shadow-factor: Yellow: lit; dark blue: in shadow.
viewHints.virtual-shadow-map-clipmap-or-mip: The shadow level each pixel reads, one colour per level.
viewHints.virtual-shadow-map-virtual-page: The shadow page each pixel reads, one colour per page.
viewHints.virtual-shadow-map-cached-page: Whether the shadow page each pixel reads was kept or redrawn.
viewHints.virtual-shadow-map-ray-count: The shadow rays traced per pixel, green to red.
viewHints.virtual-shadow-map-general-debug: The distance to each pixel's shadow occluder, as grey.
viewHints.virtual-shadow-map-dirty-page: The shadow pages drawn this image.
viewHints.virtual-shadow-map-gpu-invalidated-page: The shadow pages moving objects invalidated.
viewHints.virtual-shadow-map-merged-page: The shadow pages whose static layer was merged.
viewHints.virtual-shadow-map-overdraw: How many times the shadow raster drew each texel.
viewHints.rect-light-atlas: The atlas of the rectangle lights' pictures.
viewHints.light-profile-atlas: The atlas of the lights' IES profiles.
viewHints.surface-cache-direct-stats: Figures of the surface cache's direct light update.
viewHints.surface-cache-indirect-stats: Figures of the surface cache's indirect light update.
viewHints.surface-cache-direct-lighting-stats: The lights the surface cache's direct update gathers, and its sizes.
viewHints.surface-cache-scene-stats: Counts of the objects and cards in the surface cache.
viewHints.surface-cache-primitive-groups: The box of every object that has surface cards.
viewHints.radiance-cache-stats: Update figures of the world's light probes.
viewHints.screen-probe-gather-debug: How many screen probes, uniform and adaptive.
viewHints.screen-probe-tile-stats: The tiles of each integration mode of the screen probes.
viewHints.screen-probe-placement: Where the screen probes stand, one quad each.
viewHints.screen-probe-traces: The rays of the probe nearest the cursor, coloured by their light.
viewHints.reflection-traces: The reflection ray of the pixel under the cursor, with its distance and light.
viewHints.radiance-cache-probes: A sphere at each light probe, coloured by the light it holds.
viewHints.scene-visualization: The scene traced from the camera, lit by the surface cache.
viewHints.material-properties: The material of the pixel under the cursor, as a table.
viewHints.texture-mip: The texture size each surface reads.
viewHints.overdraw: How many times each pixel is drawn.
viewHints.heterogeneous-volumes-dda-marching: The light through the volume's voxel grid, found by DDA marching; needs a heterogeneous volume.
viewHints.heterogeneous-volumes-sample-marching: The light through the volume's voxel grid, found by sample marching; needs a heterogeneous volume.
viewHints.heterogeneous-volumes-sample-majorant: The light through the volume's voxel grid, found by majorant samples; needs a heterogeneous volume.
viewHints.heterogeneous-volumes-sample-max-majoran: The light through the volume's voxel grid, found by max majorant samples; needs a heterogeneous volume.
viewHints.heterogeneous-volumes-sample-majorant-dd: The light through the volume's voxel grid, found by majorant DDA samples; needs a heterogeneous volume.
viewHints.heterogeneous-volumes-delta-tracking: The light through the volume's voxel grid, found by delta tracking; needs a heterogeneous volume.
viewHints.heterogeneous-volumes-ratio-tracking: The light through the volume's voxel grid, found by ratio tracking; needs a heterogeneous volume.
viewHints.heterogeneous-volumes-spectral-ratio-tra: The light through the volume's voxel grid, found by spectral ratio tracking; needs a heterogeneous volume.
viewHints.heterogeneous-volumes-tracking-majorant-: The light through the volume's voxel grid, found by majorant DDA tracking; needs a heterogeneous volume.

soft-bodies.banner: Drop squashy volumes on the step. Set the pressure of their gas, or 0 for the default.

a-cooked-flag.banner: The flag was cooked with its model: it is restored as the model loads, and sags from its pole at once. Load it again to watch.

words.credit: Flag on a pole modelled in code for this example, CC0 — see assets/examples/CREDITS.md

an-elevation-of-the-house.banner: Choose a house elevation. Move the camera farther away: the orthographic drawing keeps exactly the same scale.

hover-to-highlight.banner: Move over the cart to highlight each part, or turn highlighting off in the panel.

a-dolly-along-the-canal.banner: Pause the dolly, replay the journey or change its speed as the camera travels along the canal.

a-folder-merged-into-one-scene.banner: Drag to inspect the street corner. The compiler merged three OBJ files from one folder into this scene.

words.credit: Street lamp model by W. Sitters, CC BY 3.0 — see assets/examples/CREDITS.md

drag-a-crate.banner: Drag a crate, a barrel or a ball across the floor. Turn snapping on to place it in half-metre steps.

outline-the-selection.banner: Click a shape to select it. Click the floor to clear the selection.

a-hundred-thousand-instances.banner: Drag to orbit the field. Change the count or view.

inside-a-component.banner: Mount or unmount the viewer. Each attachment owns one world and each removal disposes it.

a-character-that-walks.banner: Drag to orbit the scene. Pause or resume the animation with Play.

a-crowd-of-characters.banner: Drag to orbit the scene. Pause or resume the animation with Play.

a-shape-that-morphs.banner: Drag to orbit the scene. Pause or resume the animation with Play.

additive-poses.banner: Drag to orbit the scene. Weight sets how much sway is added on top of the walk; pause or resume it with Play.

move-a-hierarchy-by-name.banner: Watch five named groups step through a seeded sequence. Switch the driver to write the same poses by hand.

choose-your-quality.banner: Pick a quality, a resolution and a view. Keep one setting as A, another as B, and press C to flip between them.

a-polished-floor.banner: Drag to walk around the hall. Lighten the floor and its mirror sinks into its own colour.

reflections-blurred-by-roughness.banner: Drag to look around. Raise the roughness: the reflections blur lane after lane, and fade from 0.6.

reflections-from-the-screen.banner: Drag to look around. Tilt the view down: a lamp that leaves the screen leaves the wet road too.

instanced-gltf.banner: Drag to turn around the valley. Scroll down among the trees.

words.credit: Valley and trees modelled in code for this example, CC0 — see assets/examples/CREDITS.md

an-ocean.banner: Drag to look around. Raise the swell, stretch the waves and lower the sun.

a-raging-sea.banner: Drag to look around the storm. Raise the waves and the wind; the lighthouse sweeps the sea.

tone-mapping-compared.banner: Drag to look around. Pick a curve and see what each keeps of the sunset, the sunlit floor and the lamps.

render-small-show-sharp.banner: Drag to look at the cage. Lower the render scale: far fewer pixels are drawn, and the image stays sharp.

thick-lines.banner: Drag to turn around. Every strand is a line whose width is counted in screen pixels: widen them, add strands, let them drift.

sculpt-a-sphere.banner: Drag on the clay to raise it, or carve it with the other tool; drag beside it to turn around.

hover-over-triangles.banner: Move over the knot: the triangle under the pointer glows, then cools along a trail.

a-voxel-painter.banner: Click the board or a face to add a voxel; Shift-click, or switch Erase on, to take one away. Drag to look around.

cooked-blocks-that-fall.banner: Each block of this model declares its own body, cooked with it: restored as the model loads, the blocks fall and settle at once. Load it again to watch.

coloured-shadows-through-glass.banner: Sunlight through stained glass lands on the floor. Move the sun, or make the glass denser.

animation-from-the-file.banner: Drag to look around. The walk comes from the file: change how many walk the ring and how fast, even backwards.

reaching-with-ik.banner: Drag to look around. Every arm reaches for the light: let it wander, or lead it with the pointer.

a-character-of-points.banner: Drag to look around. A dancer of points, bent by a skeleton: change how many points and how fast it dances.

a-face-that-talks.banner: Drag to turn around the bust. Its lips, mouth and teeth share three morph targets, played syllable by syllable.

a-galloping-horse.banner: Drag to look around. Slow the gallop down to watch each hoof land in turn.

a-herd-of-morphs.banner: Drag to look around. One shape and one clip for the whole herd; each creature hops with its own weights.

morph-and-skin-together.banner: Drag to turn around the plant. Bones bend each leaf while a morph target curls it: blend the curl, change the wind.

fog-on-the-ground.banner: Drag to look around. The fog fills the valley and thins with height: change how thick it is, how fast it thins and where it starts.

paint-where-you-click.banner: Press on the vase and drag to paint. Hold still and the turning wheel lays a band all round. Drag beside it to turn the view.

pixel-art-render.banner: Drag to turn the island, scroll to zoom. Change the pixel size and the palette.

a-line-that-draws-itself.banner: A spirograph whose line draws itself: the dash of one line grows behind the pen. Pick a wheel and a hole; drag to look around.

decals-on-a-surface.banner: Move over the pebble to see the projector box; click to cut a sticker from the surface under it. Drag to turn the view.

procedural-wood-and-noise.banner: Drag to look around. Every texel is grown from noise in the page: pick a wood, saw new logs.

a-toolpath-in-lines.banner: A real G-code file, read in the page and drawn as lines while the nozzle prints it. Drag to turn; lower Top layer to cut the part.

pick-an-instance.banner: Point at a hex to name it among the 1,519 placements of one shape; click to pick it and send a ripple across the island.

shapes-from-an-svg.banner: An SVG read path by path, each filled shape cut out of card with its holes. Spread the layers, or drop an SVG of your own on the page.

boolean-shapes.banner: Drag to turn around. Pick an operation; turn drifting on and a worker cuts the shape again as it moves.

a-convex-hull.banner: The smallest convex solid around a moving swarm, rebuilt from nothing on every frame. Change the points and the cloud; drag to look around.

contact-shadow-under-a-car.banner: Drag to orbit. Widen the lamp, lift the car or make it hop: its shadow clings to the tyres.

contact-shadows-from-the-screen.banner: Drag to orbit, scroll to come close. Every leg and trace keeps its hairline of shadow.

light-that-bounces.banner: Drag to look into the room. Switch bounce off and on: the patch of sun lights the whole room.

voxel-models.banner: MagicaVoxel files read in the page, hidden faces dropped, corners shaded by their neighbours. Drag to turn; lower Height to cut the model open.

red-cyan-anaglyph.banner: Put on red-cyan glasses, red lens on the left eye. Drag to turn, scroll to move closer.

cross-fade-between-scenes.banner: Two worlds, one camera. Drag to turn; pick how one scene gives way to the other.

a-refracting-pane.banner: Drag to look around. The glass bends what lies behind it: change its relief, its index and its thickness.

pick-lines-and-points.banner: Move the pointer over the globe: the nearest star or line within reach lights up. One raycast meets both: a star on its dot, a line within a reach in world units.

printable-parts.banner: STL, PLY, AMF and 3MF files, each read by a few dozen lines in the page. Drag to turn; pick a part to look at it closely.

avif-textures.banner: Drag to look around. The view and the olive branch are AVIF files: lower the quality and look out of the window.

smoothing-by-subdivision.banner: Drag to turn around. Raise the level to cut every triangle in four; amber edges are creases and stay sharp.

motion-retargeting.banner: Drag to orbit. CesiumMan's walk, rewritten for two skeletons with other bone names, sizes and rest poses. Switch the method to see what each step fixes.

breaking-things.banner: Click to throw an iron ball. The wall, the pillar and the crystal are cut into Voronoi pieces, welded by joints that snap past their strength.

a-ground-projected-sky.banner: Drag to walk round the armillary: the pictured floor stays under it, and takes its shadows. Untick Grounded to see a plain sphere slide.

words.credit: Panoramas painted by this page, in code, when it opens: nothing is downloaded.

sound-in-space.banner: Press Listen (headphones are best), then orbit and zoom: each source sounds from where it glows, placed around your head by a Web Audio panner that follows the camera.

words.listening: Listening: orbit round a source, come close, or step behind the horn to leave its cone.

drag-objects.banner: Drag a piece across the stage, onto another to stack it, or into the others to shove them. Hold Shift to lift it on an upright plane.

oriented-boxes.banner: Drag to turn around. Cyan boxes turn with their shapes, amber ones keep to the world's axes; red means two boxes meet.

edit-a-spline.banner: Drag a golden handle and the curve follows; hold Shift to raise or lower it. Double-click the floor to add a handle, a handle to remove it.

compressed-mesh-input.banner: Drag to look around. One glTF holds this marble bust three times: plain floats, Draco and meshopt. The compiler decodes both codecs while it cooks, so the browser needs no decoder. Pick a bust to read its file.

lens-flares.banner: Drag to swing the view: the ghosts slide through the middle of the picture, and dim each time a blade cuts the sun.

particles-with-own-sizes.banner: Each spark is a sprite with its own size: fat comets, fine glitter, embers that shrink as they cool. Widen the size spread, or launch a shell.

an-atmospheric-sky.banner: Drag to look around. The sky is computed from the air itself: slide the hour, thicken the haze or the air.

lit-by-an-hdr-image.banner: Drag to turn around. Each place is a real HDR photograph: its sun becomes a light with shadows, the rest a soft light from every side.

words.credit: HDR images: Rosendal Plains 2, Venice Sunset, Golden Bay — Poly Haven, CC0

adjusting-the-environment.banner: Drag to turn around. Turn, warm, saturate or dim the light around the set: every change is a few numbers, applied to the light, the shadows and the background alike.
